# Windsurf is now Devin Desktop.

## NO NEW RELEASE. Still tops at v3.8.20, August 21, 2026.

## v3.8.20 (Aug 21) — reported 2026-08-23, MEDIUM/ENDPOINT
The reportable item: settings now "control whether **TERMINAL AND USER-EDIT ACTIVITY SHARE WITH ACP
AGENTS**." The receiving side (docs.devin.ai/desktop/acp) is the finding:
  - ACP = Agent Client Protocol, **JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdin/stdout**; the EDITOR LAUNCHES THE AGENT
    AS A SUBPROCESS.
  - Supported: **Codex, Claude Agent, OpenCode, and any other ACP-compatible agent, "including
    agents built by your team in-house."**
  - Third-party agents appear in the Kanban view ALONGSIDE Devin, SHARE THE SPACES CONTEXT LAYER,
    and "operate with the same controls as native sessions" — peers, not sandboxed guests.
  - Pro, Max and Teams.
  => Two data classes leave the endpoint to a party the vendor does not operate: TERMINAL OUTPUT
     (env vars, connection strings, tokens echoed by CLI tools, failed auth contents) and
     USER-EDIT ACTIVITY (proprietary source BEFORE it reaches version control, bypassing every
     SCM-anchored control). Because ACP is open and in-house agents are explicitly supported, the
     destination is NOT enumerable from the vendor surface — the SETTING'S STATE per machine is the
     only local evidence the flow is active. Required collection target.
Adjacent scope items: **workspace trust prompts now appear when needed to activate local agents**
(per-workspace trust decision a developer makes unilaterally = readable posture signal), and
**multi-root workspaces with virtual filesystem folders** (a virtual root can compose directories
no single project boundary contains, widening what one session sees).

## Remaining v3.8.20 items — held below the bar
Agent Command Center adapts to selected workspace + separate-window setting; faster Agent<->Editor
switching; Windows explicit restart confirmation; session-tab renaming; enterprise ACU-limit request
link; plan mode full Markdown file + explicit Implement button; stopping individual subagents;
Cascade-legacy status indicators; Devin Cloud sidebar filter/sort, live shell output streaming,
terminal cards following newest output, Copy Session URL, network-config conflict reporting.

Updated: 2026-08-24 — no new release. Both sources.json entries still wrong; recommendation outstanding.
